# openai_workload_identity_federation_rule (Data Source)

Retrieve a workload identity federation rule.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_workload_identity_federation_rule" "example" {
  workload_identity_provider_id        = "workload_identity_provider_123"
  workload_identity_federation_rule_id = "workload_identity_federation_rule_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `workload_identity_federation_rule_id` (String) workload identity federation rule id
- `workload_identity_provider_id` (String) workload identity provider id
